nodes.title: Mock Neck Side-Pleat Mini Dress
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A sleek sleeveless mini with a high mock neck and sculpted pleats that flare out from metal ring details at each hip.

  • Polyester with a smooth matte finish
  • Fitted bodice, princess seams, metal ring hardware
  • Sleeveless, above-knee length (about 35–36 in)

Sizes S–XL · Bust 34–39 in

nodes.title: Floral Satin Blazer Mini Set
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A matching set of a cropped floral blazer and a high-waist mini with a front slit, printed in soft pink and mint peonies.

  • Polyester satin with a soft sheen, lined blazer
  • Cropped double-breasted blazer (about 17–18 in), gold-tone buttons
  • High-waist skort-style mini (about 14 in), front slit

Sizes S–L · Bust 38–41 in · Waist 25–28 in

nodes.title: Cowl Neck Satin Maxi Dress
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A glossy satin maxi with a draped cowl neckline, a low open back and a high side slit.

  • Satin-finish fabric with a high sheen
  • Close fit, adjustable spaghetti straps, side zip, elastic back
  • Floor-length maxi (about 55–56 in), thigh-high slit

Sizes S–L · Bust 30–33 in

nodes.title: Two-Button Notch Lapel Long Coat
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A roomy burgundy coat with wide notch lapels and dropped shoulders, cut long to layer over knits.

  • Polyester with a brushed, wool-look texture, black lining
  • Relaxed fit, two-button front, flap hip pockets
  • Below-knee length (about 45–46 in)

Sizes XS–L · Bust 43–48 in

nodes.descriptionHtml:

  • Faux leather upper, textile lining, TPR sole
  • Pull-on, buckle strap at the top, round toe
  • Mid-calf shaft (about 12.5 in), 1.2 in stacked heel

US 5.5–10 (EU 36–42)

  • Three D-ring buckle straps, almond toe
  • Below-knee shaft (about 14 in), 2.4 in block heel

  • Pull-on, pointed toe with a burnished tip
  • Ankle shaft (about 6 in), 3.2 in stacked block heel

  • Flat cushioned sole

  • Wide single band, slip-on, open peep toe
  • Platform wedge (about 4 in)

  • Side zip, snap-button trim, small metal charm
  • Knee-high shaft (about 14 in), 2.8 in block heel
